description: Probe the next QKV union after a one-example miss
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,639 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 54 prior macro-attempts and 488 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0155/micro-0001 at 1,639/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0156/micro-0001, where QKV pair 672/271 missed qualification by one example at 1,638/98.99%. Five sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: the one-example miss is pair-specific, as attempt 155 already found a qualifying pair after three failures, so the next unmeasured minimum-difference union can still qualify. The helper uses one official runner trial per ordered union with exact rollback. Stop at first scored failure/error, 20 trials, no pair, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than recalibrating temperature around the failed pair because the earlier six-point calibration showed that local compensation is low-yield.
summary: The skip-path QKV automation evaluated five ordered unions. Four consecutive pairs qualified and reduced the retained frontier from 1,639 to 1,635 parameters; the fifth proposed 1,634 parameters, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 4 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used five official checkpoint migrations/verifications over about 6m50s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap, confirming nonmonotonic coordinate sensitivity.
